answer: Made: WROTE is the one pause signal (PAUSED gone), busy and at-once answers share one pause path, one history read per order, ClaimRows shared by both claims, Ended's stale branch gone. Kept Current, as a guard, not a branch: it is the renewal rule in CallOutside (dropping it is the broken variant failed_never_done fails on) and the lease guard of every write in Ended.
